originality.rationale: The exact faulted type and relative map follow mechanically from the earlier star-cluster decomposition and edge-deletion cofibration plus the already known integral intact type. Here is the decisive implication, which is stronger than noting shared ingredients. Fix v=(0,0), and let K=st(v)∩SC(v), with SC(v) the union of the stars of its four neighbors w; put L_w=st(v)∩st(w). Antolín Camarena–Carnero Bravo Lemmas 21 and 18 identify each L_w with I(G_{3,3})≃S² (open and closed neighborhood unions agree for adjacent v,w; their Eq. (1) gives h(0,3)=1). In the notation of their Theorem 23 proof, K=A∪B, the unions of the two L_w on either side of v. Within each side the intersection is contractible by Lemma 21, and the proof of Theorem 23 at r=2 gives A∩B a wedge of 2-spheres, in particular H̃₁(A∩B)=0. Two applications of Mayer–Vietoris show that the four inclusion-induced H̃₂(L_w) classes generate H̃₂(K). The star and star cluster are contractible and cover I(G), by the triangle-free star-cluster construction. The natural Mayer–Vietoris boundary identifies H̃₃(I(G)) with H̃₂(K), which is Z by the published intact type. The stabilizer of v is transitive on its four neighbors (cycle reflection and permutation of the other two colors), so each of the four generator images in Z has the same absolute value. Since they generate, that value is 1. Applied naturally to the two cones v*L_w and w*L_w, the same Mayer–Vietoris boundary identifies the map H̃₃(ΣL_w)→H̃₃(I(G)) with H̃₂(L_w)→H̃₂(K). Thus the attaching map in Adamaszek Proposition 3.4 has degree ±1 onto the sole intact 3-sphere: the intact complex is 2-connected, so Hurewicz detects this S³ map. Its homotopy cofiber is the three intact S⁴ summands; the inclusion is their wedge projection, and the quotient is Σ²L_w with connecting degree ±1. This uses explicit earlier decomposition and intersection statements, ordinary exactness and symmetry; no faulted complex enumeration or new attaching computation is required. The earlier sources do not need to name the exact deleted graph in a headline for this implication to hold.
